posts.title: Research journey begins
posts.body: I am following [this guide](https://irregular-rhomboid.github.io/2025/08/15/hitchhikers-guide-to-research.html) and thus have vibe coded the update to my website to do so. We will try to see if there is any value trying to connect topology or differential geometry to adversarial attacks. I'm trying to link these two as I enjoy both of these topics. I really like pure maths. I prefer proofs to experimental data. Let's see what we can do. I'll be doing short writeups on here after my lit review.

posts.title: still going strong
posts.body: some potential success with joining a SOAR team is on the horizon. Currently collabing with an old professor of mine as well

posts.title: Do models see the same sky?
posts.body: We have begun the journey of doing research in a more mature capacity. This time, we will investigate if representations of models converge to a particular "underlying ideal" using astronomical data. I got lucky and was accepted into SOAR for this project. I also am doubly lucky that a project that isn't necessarily adversarial ML targeted my research taste exactly. Though I still feel like there can be a tie in with adversarial ML andd this work sometime in the future. Onward!
